source.name: PR Newswire (Little Caesars Pizza / Olympia Entertainment)
source.quote: Olympia Entertainment and Little Caesars today announced a naming rights partnership establishing Little Caesars Arena as the name of Detroit’s new, 20,000+ seat downtown arena.
source.note: Announced 28 April 2016; the release puts the term at 20 years from 2017, when the arena opened.

note: Arena naming rights: Little Caesars Arena. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2016-04-28.
